title: Hindsight Bias
coreMove: Detect when the hindsight pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Hindsight Bias as a specific decision error around hindsight, forecast record, memory edit. Traceable support includes Hindsight =/= Fore- sight: The effect of outcome knowledge on judgment under uncertainty.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Hindsight Bias as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: detect when the hindsight pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.

hook: Do not open with a definition of Hindsight Bias.
Do not use a generic panic-at-a-meeting opener.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable shape where the obvious answer is wrong and the opposite is true.
Do not make Hindsight Bias sound like ordinary carelessness.
examples: No coffee mug, classroom whiteboard, bus depot, radiator, bike helmet, or narrow kitchen shell.
No example may skip the specific mechanics of Hindsight Bias.
